spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of New Taipei Metropolitan Park; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Late afternoon at New Taipei Metropolitan Park from image 3: a vast riverside lawn, gentle grass slopes and wide paths, the elevated expressway and Sanchong apartment towers in the distance, golden light. The grass slopes are plain green with no lettering, no giant letters and no park name anywhere. The woman and the man sit very close together on a park bench, shoulders touching, she leans her head lightly toward him, both smiling quietly. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack; the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
